title: *Cs627 GDB Solution*
text:
*Cs627 GDB Solution*

No
Reason 1: If the database gets hacked, the plain-text passwords can be read directly, so every student account is exposed and the hashed copy gives no protection at all.

Reason 2: Storing the plain-text version cancels the purpose of hashing, and account recovery should be done by a reset link or a temporary password instead of looking at the original password.
